kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أعترض (form VIII)
# أَعْتَرِضُ (ʔaʕtariḍu) /ʔaʕ.ta.ri.dˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# أُعْتَرَضُ (ʔuʕtaraḍu) /ʔuʕ.ta.ra.dˤu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# أَعْتَرِضَ (ʔaʕtariḍa) /ʔaʕ.ta.ri.dˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# أُعْتَرَضَ (ʔuʕtaraḍa) /ʔuʕ.ta
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
